lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized into approximately five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits; centroid spacing between spots increases progressively toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a coordinate-like grid where the high-luminance blobs serve as primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal intensity gradient is visible along the upper flank, indicating a structural ridge with higher luminance values on the dorsal-facing aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral-facing aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 12-14 discrete high-luminance blobs, concentrated primarily along the leading edge and the basal region of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, lower-radius high-luminance spots compared to the spatial distribution on the lateral flank.
